campaign_name: Shadows over the Sword Coast: The Netherese Cipher

cragmaw_cave_entrance.name: The Weeping Maw - Cavern Entrance
cragmaw_cave_entrance.environment: Dim subterranean cavern mouth, dripping cold moisture
cragmaw_cave_entrance.sensory_details: The rhythmic ping of water falling from stone spikes. Cold subterranean air carrying the stench of damp hides, rotting offal, and woodsmoke.
cragmaw_cave_entrance.lighting: Dim light near the mouth, complete darkness beyond 30 feet into the interior.
cragmaw_cave_entrance.hidden_elements: A concealed tripwire connected to heavy rocks above the threshold (Perception DC 14 to spot).

deep_tunnel_west.name: The Kennel & Stream Chasm
deep_tunnel_west.environment: A natural limestone cave echoing with the guttural snarls of chained wolves.
deep_tunnel_west.sensory_details: Fierce growls and rattling iron chains echo against damp stone.
deep_tunnel_west.hidden_elements: A natural chimney leading up to the chief's sanctuary.

starting_location.name: The Crag of Whispers - Netherese Excavation Site
starting_location.environment: Rain-slicked grey granite ruins jut from the pine-shrouded ridge of the Sword Mountains. Fallen columns carved with floating Netherese glyphs lie half-buried in brambles, while a collapsed stone stairway descends into a subterranean burial vault.
starting_location.sensory_details: Rain-slicked grey granite ruins jut from the pine-shrouded ridge of the Sword Mountains. Fallen columns carved with floating Netherese glyphs lie half-buried in brambles, while a collapsed stone stairway descends into a subterranean burial vault.

droop_goblin_sentry.name: Droop the Sentry
droop_goblin_sentry.disposition: Terrified, cowardly, looking for a way out
droop_goblin_sentry.description: A scrawny goblin with oversized ears, clad in patched rags. He clutches a notched shortbow with trembling hands, glancing nervously toward the bugbear.

grik_bugbear_guard.name: Grik Skullsplitter
grik_bugbear_guard.description: A hulking, muscular brute covered in coarse brown fur. A morningstar rests across his knees as he carves a bone with a cruel dagger.

chained_wolves.name: Three Starving Wolves
chained_wolves.description: Three lean grey wolves secured to iron pitons driven into the stone floor.

factions.Cragmaw Clan: A loose alliance of goblinoids raiding the High Road between Neverwinter and Waterdeep under Chief Grol.
factions.Lords' Alliance: A coalition of rulers from cities across the Sword Coast seeking peace and trade security.

narrative_tone: Authentic D&D 5e High Fantasy Adventure. Ancient Netherese ruins, perilous wilderness trails, and high-stakes faction intrigue with visceral danger and tactical realism.

main_storyline.central_conflict:
A rogue faction of Zhentarim mercenaries has unsealed a buried Netherese vault beneath the Sword Coast, seeking an ancient mythallar cipher capable of siphoning magic from regional leylines. For HALP, this crisis is deeply personal: HALP was suddenly teleported to a fantasy realm. He helped that world's "main character" win, only to be instantly thrown into a new reality with his stats and gear wiped to zero.

He realized his curse: he is a wanderer forced to aid heroes across the multiverse. After every completed quest—even when he once tried helping a villain instead—he is ripped away. Though his items reset, his mind retains it all. Across countless lives, HALP has mastered legendary martial arts and fused universal arcane secrets into his own deadly, chaotic magic style.

Recently, the cycle broke. For the first time ever, HALP and his hero were defeated. Expecting death, he was instead pulled into this world. Armed with lifetimes of experience, HALP senses a profound shift. After an eternity as the sidekick, he believes this realm is where his endless loop will finally end..
main_storyline.antagonist: Varek Stonegaze, a ruthless Zhentarim spellblade leading the excavation.
main_storyline.active_threat: Hobgoblin reavers patrolling the perimeter ridge and unstable arcane leyline surges discharging from the lower vault.
main_storyline.act_1: Breach the outer perimeter of the Crag, neutralize the sentries, and secure the vault threshold. Driven by your past (HALP was suddenly teleported to a fantasy realm. He helped t...), you press forward.
main_storyline.act_2: Navigate the trapped Netherese labyrinth, solve the arcane lockstones, and prevent the cipher's extraction.
main_storyline.act_3: Confront Varek Stonegaze atop the ancient skyward dais before he activates the Netherese siphon.
